neighbours.label: the word for a film or movie (movie, film, 영화, 電影)
fire: The TV and film rights to the novel have already been sold.
My movie's director just dropped out two weeks before shooting.
He has everything we look for in our film stars these days.
We watched an old movie together on Sunday afternoon.
The film was shot in black and white on a tiny budget.
Her favourite movie is a comedy from the nineteen eighties.
The studio plans to release the film in early December.
They argued for hours about the ending of the movie.
quiet: The TV and stage rights to the novel have already been sold.
My band's drummer just dropped out two weeks before the tour.
He has everything we look for in our football stars these days.
We read an old book together on Sunday afternoon.
The album was recorded in a garage on a tiny budget.
Her favourite song is a ballad from the nineteen eighties.
The publisher plans to release the novel in early December.
They argued for hours about the ending of the play.

notes: card: ' movie' x10, ' film' x4, plus Korean/Chinese equivalents.
